title: Get paid for your personal data
summary: Users own their data and sell it to advertisers directly.
whyTempting: Feels fair; Big Tech profits from data that users give away.
whyItFails: Data is worth very little per person. Payouts are cents, not dollars. Buyers don't need you. Advertisers already get data elsewhere. Trust and privacy concerns. Selling data contradicts privacy motivations.
whatWouldChange: Data for AI training with clear rights might create genuinely valuable individual data.

attempts.notes: Pays users in tokens for viewing ads; publishers objected to Brave replacing their ads.

attempts.outcome: Paid users for data; ended on iPhone after Apple banned it

reasons.detail: Data is worth very little per person: Payouts are cents, not dollars.
Buyers don't need you: Advertisers already get data elsewhere.
Trust and privacy concerns: Selling data contradicts privacy motivations.
